name: harken-th-sarcasm
description: Real comments harvested during the Jensen Huang run, hand-labelled. Exists because sentiment_v1.json is 60 easy English praise/complaint sentences and scores near 1.0, which tells us nothing about the sarcastic Thai replies that actually reach the dashboard. Every line here was read and judged by a human; sarcasm is labelled as the intent, not the words.
notes: label = pos/neu/neg poles used by the charts. emotion = the specific feeling. sarcasm = 1 when the literal words mean the opposite of the intent. ambiguity is kept on purpose: an item a human cannot call confidently is not a fair test.
